_readme: Per-block em-dash remedies for the cases scripts/convert-em-dash-native.js refuses to decide. Key is the block's whitespace-collapsed visible text; value is one remedy code per em dash in that block, in order: . full stop  : colon  , comma  ( ) parenthesis pair  x drop the dash (redundant against punctuation already there)  _ leave it alone (a list marker, a specimen). A decision, never an entry added to make a gate pass; an unjudged block stays exactly as it is and is reported by --defer-out.
